method: A provisional, evidence-marked assessment of all 69 registered surface cards. Scores use the v0.3 brand and strategy rubrics. A score based on a representative public destination is labelled as such; it is a diagnostic score, not publication approval or proof that every asset in the category was reviewed.

Homepage.basis: Public ADL corporate homepage reviewed directly.
Homepage.recommendation: Move the legacy corporate homepage onto the current IC positioning and correct the CTA contrast failure.

Contact / inquiry.recommendation: Use the inquiry page to qualify owner-led IC programs and fix the essential CTA contrast.

About Us.basis: Public legacy About page and shared corporate visual system reviewed.
About Us.recommendation: Replace broad climate-innovation framing with ADL’s IC program role and current evidence.

Owners & Developers.basis: Public page reviewed; unrelated template content creates a publication hold.
Owners & Developers.recommendation: Remove unrelated retreat/refund content, then establish the owner program proposition.

ROAD to IC.basis: Public page reviewed; leadership/history claims require source verification.
ROAD to IC.recommendation: Retain the program narrative, cite leadership/history claims, and rebuild in the current brand system.

IC Summit homepage.basis: Public summit destination reviewed; it uses a separate program identity.
IC Summit homepage.recommendation: Keep its clear IC outcome framing and document the approved relationship between summit and ADL branding.

Company profile.recommendation: Rewrite the profile around owner-controlled IC programs, decisions, and proof of role.

ADL YouTube channel.basis: Public channel and visible video metadata reviewed.
ADL YouTube channel.recommendation: Link every published title and description to its video ID and lead with an IC decision or outcome.

Nolan Browne · profile.basis: Public LinkedIn profile reviewed as a representative executive profile.
Nolan Browne · profile.recommendation: Tie individual expertise to ADL’s specific role in owner-led IC programs.

Colby Swanson · profile.basis: Public LinkedIn profile reviewed as a representative executive profile.
Colby Swanson · profile.recommendation: Make the connection between personal expertise, ADL’s system role, and current proof more explicit.

Who We Serve.basis: Representative legacy corporate destination and shared visual system reviewed.
Who We Serve.recommendation: Organize audiences around owner decisions and IC program needs, not generic verticals.

Construction.basis: Representative legacy corporate destination and shared visual system reviewed.
Construction.recommendation: State the construction role within an owner-governed IC delivery system.

Energy & Utilities.basis: Representative legacy corporate destination and shared visual system reviewed.
Energy & Utilities.recommendation: Connect energy work to repeatable asset programs, proof, and deployment decisions.

Transportation.recommendation: Frame transportation work as an IC program with outcomes, roles, and evidence.

Portfolio.recommendation: Convert portfolio entries into sourced case evidence with decision, role, and result.

Accelerators.basis: Representative legacy corporate destination and shared visual system reviewed.
Accelerators.recommendation: Explain how each accelerator advances the deployment engine and who acts next.

Blog / Insights.basis: Representative legacy corporate destination and shared visual system reviewed.
Blog / Insights.recommendation: Publish decision-led insights with a named audience, evidence, and next action.

Case Studies.recommendation: Add dated, attributable outcomes and clarify ADL’s specific role in each case.

Uptake newsletter.recommendation: Collect each send and evaluate headline, CTA, audience, and brand attribution as a distinct weekly artifact.
